git_failure.error: fatal: not a git repository (or any parent up to mount point /workspace)

root_cause: Packages published after sandbox startup exposed shared Git metadata. A native commit copied only mutated metadata into the private upper, leaving other files dependent on the shared repository after deletion.
fix: Before exposing a newly discovered package Git entry, the filesystem requests initialization from the existing Git owner. It retains read-only objects and atomically installs confined private metadata built outside developer-visible mounts.
